title: Craftable Command Block
description: This project makes command blocks craftable! A shame that you can't use them in survival but may be useful for some kind of maps!
body:
This datapack makes command blocks craftable! A shame that you can't use them in survival but may be useful for some kind of maps!

Here's the crafting recipe:

![pretty expensive](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79bc946028ea1fc924482b46d5e8d961365e0391.png)

*crafts an item that when you hit a mob with creates the command blocks and deletes itself

**if there are players in creative mode but without op dont download this datapack, cuz they'll be able to use the command blocks to their advantage
